annotations.title: chainpeek: recent large trades on a token, who is buying and selling, on Base or Ethereum

description: chainpeek: Who is buying this token? Recent large trades: big buys and sells on Base or Ethereum. For Solana use get_large_solana_token_trades; for a quote at your size use get_swap_quote. Returns who bought and sold an ERC-20 in size: the recent large buys and sells of it on Base or Ethereum from DEX swap events (Uniswap V2/V3, Aerodrome): time, side, token amount, USD size, the transaction sender's wallet, tx hash and pool, newest first, at most 50. Size-based only, no wallet is labelled; read from swap events of the top 3 pools, so it can miss trades elsewhere; amounts are heuristic; a bad address or a window over 60 minutes (Base) or 240 (Ethereum) is a 422 (not charged); Base logs reach about 27 min back (window.complete); cached 30 s. Typically 3 to 6 s (pool discovery, header and log reads, senders), at most 25 s. Price: USD 0.01. Free: 10 chain reads per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/token-large-trades-api.html

min_usd.description: Smallest trade to report, in USD of the quote side (default 1000, minimum 100).

window_minutes.description: How far back to read, in minutes. At most 60 on Base and 240 on Ethereum. The window is cut by block times; public nodes serve logs only about 8,000 blocks deep (about 27 minutes on Base), so a longer Base window is read as its newest 8,000 blocks and `window` says what was read.

name: get_large_token_trades

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.
